notes:
VP Studio 0.61 — everything since 0.42.

New: Home tab (recent jobs + your jobs folders, with previews); a real Settings window (File > Settings) covering display, jobs folder, startup, printing, batch defaults, ink cost, media sizes, updates and license; machine-config export/import (one .vpconfig file moves sizes, profiles and settings to another PC); smart alignment guides on the canvas; media sizes managed from one shared catalog everywhere.

Refreshed look across the suite: toolbar, properties panel, Print page, Data page, navigation tabs, placement popup, menus, and a new app icon.

Fixes: belt-speed gauge no longer freezes during over-speed (shows "(last)" when a reading is stale); canceling a job in the printer queue is caught in more places and escalates to a full abort if the popup already moved on.
